description.value:
Duration permanent

A minor standing contact in the Underledger network — a fence, a lookout, a door that's always unlocked for you.

Choose one contact in the Underledger: a fence who buys without asking, a lookout who passes word, or a door that is always unlocked for you. In any settlement where the Underledger has a presence, you can reach that contact with an hour's effort. Once per day the contact will do one minor thing for you at no cost — move a small item, carry a message, or let you through — and will not take a risk it considers real.
